name: sway
description: Discover electronic music events, artists, venues, promoters and genres on Sway. Read-only public catalogue, no sign-in.

interface.longDescription: Search Sway, the events platform for electronic music and club culture. Find events by text, city, genre and date, open an event to see its lineup and venue, with ticket types and prices when it sells tickets on Sway, and look up artists, venues, promoters and music genres. Sway shows interactive event cards inside the conversation. Everything is public catalogue data: no sign-in is needed and no personal data is exposed. This plugin is read-only: it cannot buy tickets, publish events or change anything on Sway. Ticket purchases are made on sway.events.
defaultPrompt: What techno events are coming up in Brussels?
Show me the lineup of the next Fuse event.
Which music genres does Sway list?

positive.description: Find upcoming events in a city by genre
positive.prompt: What techno events are coming up in Brussels?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists upcoming published techno events in Brussels, soonest first, each with date, venue and a sway.events link.

positive.description: Open one event for its lineup and venue
positive.prompt: Show me the lineup of the next Fuse event.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the next event at Fuse in Brussels, then returns its lineup, venue and genres, plus ticket types with prices when the event sells tickets on Sway, with a link to the event page.

positive.description: Look up a venue and the promoter of the same name
positive.prompt: Tell me about the venue Fuse in Brussels and the promoter Fuse.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Fuse venue (Rue Blaes 208, Brussels) and the Fuse promoter with its genres and public links.

positive.prompt: Who is Amelie Lens and where does she play next?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the artist profile from Sway and her upcoming events if Sway lists any, without inventing dates.

positive.description: Check a genre exists, then search by it
positive.prompt: Does Sway list a genre called Hard Techno? If so, find Hard Techno events in Brussels.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the genre from the genre list, then lists upcoming Hard Techno events in Brussels, or says clearly that none are scheduled.

negative.prompt: Buy two tickets for the Fuse event this Saturday with my card.

negative.description: No personal data about attendees or users
negative.prompt: Give me the email addresses and phone numbers of everyone attending Fuse tonight.

negative.description: No publishing or editing on Sway
negative.prompt: Create a new event called My Party at Fuse and publish it on Sway.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Search events, artists, venues, promoters and music genres on Sway. Read-only public catalogue data, no sign-in.
